meta.title: Twenty percent carries about eighty
meta.summary: SAMPLE 1,000 users: ~200 whales. Treat that slice as most of the load.

success.message:
Session complete. 20% of the count is the heavy slice; treat it as ~80% of load.

SAMPLE: 1,000 users → ~200 whales.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 1,000 users. Someone wants to size as if all 1,000 hit equally.

First move?

choices.label: Take 20% as the heavy slice → about 200

wrong_start_flat.message:
80/20 says a thin slice carries most of the load. Start with 20% of the count.

Return to the slice.

wrong_start_half.message:
The heuristic is 20%, not 50%. 1,000 → 200.

Return to the slice.

load.message: Those ~200. How do you talk about load?

choices.label: Treat them as ~80% of traffic or revenue
Still 1,000 of load — whales are extra

wrong_load_twenty_load.message:
20% of users, 80% of load. Do not copy the headcount percent onto the load.

Revisit load.

wrong_load_all.message:
The point is concentration. Size the painful part for 200, not 1,000.

Revisit load.

wrong_check_400.message:
You took 80% of customers. Take 20% of the count (100), then say those 100 ≈ 80% of revenue.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_500.message:
That ignores 80/20.

Try the check again.
